verdict.rationale: Ramp documents automatic receipt capture the moment a card is swiped, with memos and categories filled in and in-policy spend auto-approved with no expense report. It also sends reminders for missing items, and its MCP and CLI tooling can find and flag transactions with missing receipts. missing for 10: explicit documentation of e-receipts pulled from named integrations (e.g., email or merchant connectors), evidence that nudges fire only for genuinely missing receipts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of matching accuracy.
